how_to_apply: Fill the application form for re-engaging of Naib-Tehsildars printed with the advertisement, in capital letters.
Attach all relevant supporting documents/certificates listed in the form.
Send the application so that it reaches the Office of Deputy Commissioner, Kinnaur at Reckong Peo, H.P. on or before 23-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Must have rendered minimum 5 years service in any wing of revenue Department of HP before superannuation; No departmental/disciplinary proceeding pending; certificate from parent department to be submitted with the application form; Medical fitness certificate from a government hospital to be submitted with the application form Experience: Minimum 5 years service in any wing of Revenue Department of H.P. before superannuation Age limit: Maximum 65 years (as on 30 November 2026) Other conditions: Only retired persons may apply; retired Tehsildars can also apply for Naib-Tehsildar No departmental/disciplinary proceeding should be pending No posting in the applicant's Home Tehsil/Sub-Tehsil

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Deputy Commissioner Kinnaur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Retirees with departmental/disciplinary proceedings pending against them Retirees with less than 5 years service in the Revenue Department of H.P.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Re-engagement for 03 months in the first instance; may be extended depending on performance or requirement Purely temporary; liable to be terminated by the appointing authority at any time Services terminated after clearance of pendency of revenue cases Liable to be terminated on availability of regular officials Period of engagement not counted for any benefits in earlier service

content_sections.text: Consideration for the post on the recommendation of the committee If applications exceed vacancies, candidates junior in age will be given preference Candidates considered on the recommendation of the committee If applications exceed vacancies, candidates junior in age get preference

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of age Proof of 5 years of service in any wing of Revenue Department of H.P. before retirement Medical fitness certificate from Government Hospital Character certificate Certificate of no disciplinary/departmental/criminal proceedings pending, issued by controlling officer of last posting before retirement

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date or found incomplete will be rejected One day's casual leave after one month of service; no other leave admissible Unauthorised absence leads to automatic termination and no emoluments for absence TA/DA for official tours at the rate of regular counterparts at minimum of pay scale Monthly remuneration paid on basis of performance/work conduct certificate from Controlling Authority Medical facilities and reimbursement continue as admissible to a retiree

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Deputy Commissioner Kinnaur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Deputy Commissioner Kinnaur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Naib-Tehsildar.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Deputy Commissioner Kinnaur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form printed on page 3 of this notice) and send it to Office of Deputy Commissioner, Kinnaur at Reckong Peo, H.P, by post, to reach by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on 30 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees who rendered minimum 5 years service in any wing of Revenue Department of HP before superannuation, with no departmental/disciplinary proceeding pending; medical fitness certificate from a government hospital. Retired Tehsildars can also apply.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only retired persons may apply; retired Tehsildars can also apply for Naib-Tehsildar. No departmental/disciplinary proceeding should be pending. No posting in the applicant's Home Tehsil/Sub-Tehsil.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retirees with departmental/disciplinary proceedings pending against them. Retirees with less than 5 years service in the Revenue Department of H.P.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consideration for the post on the recommendation of the committee. If applications exceed vacancies, candidates junior in age will be given preference. Candidates considered on the recommendation of the committee. If applications exceed vacancies, candidates junior in age get preference.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Re-engagement for 03 months in the first instance; may be extended depending on performance or requirement. Purely temporary; liable to be terminated by the appointing authority at any time. Services terminated after clearance of pendency of revenue cases.
